Predicates:
AllowedPets(x) ::: Pets are allowed in building x.
DepositRequired(y) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment.
DepositAmount(z) ::: The deposit amount is z.
CanBeEqualOrMore(z, w) ::: The deposit can be equal to or more than w.
Pets(x) ::: x is a pet.
Fluffy ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat.
Cats(x) ::: x is a cat.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
Rent(x, y) ::: The rent in building x is y.
WillRent(x, y) ::: x will rent an apartment in building y.
MoveInWith(x, y) ::: x can move in with y.
Premises:
Pets(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a pet.
Cats(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a cat.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
Rent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
AllowedPets(oliveGarden) ::: Pets are allowed in the Olive Garden.
TomWillRent ⇔ (MoveInWith(Tom, Fluffy) ∧ DepositAmount(d) ∧ CanBeEqualOrMore(d, 1500)) ::: Tom will rent if and only if he can move in with Fluffy and the deposit is no more than $1500.
DepositAmount(2000) ::: The deposit amount is $2000.
Premises:
DepositAmount(2000) ::: The deposit amount is $2000.
CanBeEqualOrMore(2000, 1500) ::: $2000 is more than $1500.
Conclusion:
DepositAmount(2000) ::: The deposit at the Olive Garden is $2000.
